plate_findings.evidence: caption: (A,B) axial and coronal views of the CT scan showing a beaver tail liver and asplenia

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A is an axial CT showing the abdomen. The caption explicitly states the image shows asplenia and a beaver tail liver. This aligns with the target disease isolated_congenital_asplenia. B: Panel B is a coronal CT scan showing the absence of the spleen, confirming the diagnosis of isolated congenital asplenia as stated in the caption and article title.
